ABOUT SMOOCHE
What is Smooche?

Smooche is a clean beauty brand dedicated to making flawless skin accessible to everyone. We create innovative, science-backed cosmetics — like our viral Color-Adapting Foundation — that use intelligent mineral pigments to adjust to your unique skin tone. Our products are clean, cruelty-free, and formulated with skin-loving ingredients so you look and feel your best every day.

Where is Smooche based?

Smooche is headquartered at 8605 Santa Monica Boulevard, PMB 44698, West Hollywood, CA 90069, USA. We ship worldwide to 65+ countries.

How do I contact Smooche?

We'd love to hear from you! You can reach our customer support team by emailing hey@smooche.com. You can also use the contact form on our Contact page. We aim to respond to all inquiries promptly.

What payment methods do you accept?

We accept all major credit cards including Visa, Mastercard, and American Express. We also support PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. Additional local payment options may be available at checkout depending on your region.

PRODUCTS
How does the Color Changing Foundation work?

Our Color Changing Foundation uses intelligent micro-encapsulated mineral pigments that react to your skin's warmth and undertones as you blend. At first touch, the pigments appear soft and neutral. As you smooth the formula across your skin, these micro-pigments disperse and warm up, revealing the perfect blend of tones your complexion needs. The result is a finish that looks like your skin — just more even, smoother, and perfectly balanced. No guesswork, no shade-matching, just effortless self-adjusting coverage.

What skin tones does the foundation work for?

Our Color Changing Foundation is designed for fair to medium skin tones and all shades in between. Our adaptive pigment formula removes the need to choose a shade — it adjusts to your unique complexion. In an eight-week independent customer panel, 97% of users said it instantly matched their skin tone.
